title: A Small Bakery in Town
text:
This month's magazine visits a small bakery in the old part of town. The bakery is run by Maria and her brother Luis. They open at six every morning and sell bread, cakes, and coffee.

Maria says the best part of her job is meeting customers. Many people come every day for a warm croissant. In the summer, the bakery also makes ice cream in the back room.

questions.text: What does Maria say is the best part of her job?
What can the reader infer about the bakery?
options: It is popular with local people
It is far from the town center
It is closed in the summer

questions.text: Why does the bakery probably make ice cream in the summer?
options: Customers want cold treats when it is hot
The bakery is in a very cold place
Ice cream is cheaper than bread

vocabulary.definition: a shop that sells bread, cakes, and other baked food
people who buy things from a shop
a soft, curved pastry made with butter

paragraph_translations: Esta revista de este mes visita una pequeña panadería en la parte antigua de la ciudad. La panadería la dirigen Maria y su hermano Luis. Abren a las seis de la mañana todos los días y venden pan, pasteles y café.
Maria dice que lo mejor de su trabajo es conocer a los clientes. Mucha gente viene todos los días a por un cruasán caliente. En verano, la panadería también hace helado en la trastienda.
